arguments.text: 8 km, 1250 m out-and-back legs. Goal: even effort near sustainable pod power (~175 W shaft, ~113 W boat) so the reserve empties at the finish; finish sprint from ~400 m. Check calibration by heart rate: steady effort at CP should level HR; climbing HR means CP set too high. Watch for incidents (weed: push_local drop with steady pod; pod drift: pod vs HR mismatch; radio course changes). Use pieces only if the answer changes pacing.
